mainEntity.name: When should I involve an interior designer in my construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is most effective to involve your interior designer during the early planning and design phases of your construction project, ideally before or concurrently with the architectural drawings. This allows their expertise to influence critical decisions regarding layouts, built-ins, lighting, and finishes from the outset. Early involvement helps avoid costly changes later in the construction process, as design elements can be integrated rather than adapted.
acceptedAnswer.description: Involve an interior designer during the early planning and design phases of your project to integrate their expertise from the start and avoid costly changes later.
